subject: *: Drop partition DDL handling for overlapping partitions during State Changes (#56082)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent, focusing on DDL/partition metadata and the overlap window during DROP PARTITION. The change introduces a new StatePublic→StateWriteOnly→StateDeleteOnly staging: first persist DroppingDefinitions plus PartitionInfo.DDLAction/DDLState without removing Definitions, then remove definitions and proceed to delete-reorg/global-index cleanup. DML/planner paths are updated to block access to dropping partitions and to redirect reads/pruning/point-get to the overlapping partition (next RANGE partition or LIST DEFAULT) during the WriteOnly skew window; new multi-domain tests assert the intended behavior for RANGE/LIST/LIST COLUMNS with DEFAULT. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, concurrency, compatibility, or metadata/state-machine handling within the touched DDL/meta logic.
